parsed.rationale: I don't think this is a normal tracing: the lead II rhythm strip is irregularly irregular (RR intervals vary from about 0.27 to 0.46 s, rate about 120-130 bpm), there are no clear P waves and the baseline has fine fibrillatory waves, best seen in V1. The QRS is narrow and there is no significant ST elevation, though the high precordial voltage could also point to LVH.
